name: Pull Apart (Cable)
instructions: Set two cable handles at chest height and cross them so your right hand holds the left handle and vice versa.
Step back with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull your arms apart until they are in line with your shoulders.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A cable pull-apart that trains the rear delts and upper back with steady tension.
